# أدواتي — Adawati Tools

> Free Arabic-first online tools for Oman and the Arab world. 50+ tools covering finance, health, files, images, dev, productivity, and games. Available in 6 languages (Arabic, English, French, Spanish, German, Russian). No login required, fully client-side, privacy-first.
> New 2026 tools (Zakat, Fuel Cost, JSON, Base64, Color, Text Case, Pomodoro) each have full localized editions under /ar/, /fr/, /es/, /de/, /ru/ with translated titles, FAQs and hreflang.

## Finance & Salary Tools (Oman)
- [End of Service Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/end-of-service.html): Oman end-of-service gratuity calculator per Article 61 of the updated Labour Law. Covers Omani nationals (SPF) and expats. Compares old vs new system.
- [Salary Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/salary-calculator.html): Oman salary calculator with Social Protection Fund (SPF) deduction. Uses insurable wage with OMR 3,000 ceiling per SPF rules.
- [Currency Converter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/currency-converter.html): Live exchange rates from ExchangeRate-API, updated every 4 hours. Covers 30+ currencies including OMR, SAR, AED, USD, EUR, GBP, EGP, INR.
- [VAT Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/vat-calculator.html): Oman VAT calculator (5%). Add or remove VAT from any price.
- [Loan Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/loan-calculator.html): Monthly installment calculator with full amortization schedule. Supports early repayment simulation.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/compound-interest.html): Investment growth calculator with compound interest and regular contributions.
- [Discount Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/discount-calculator.html): Calculate price after discount percentage.
- [Tip Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/tip-calculator.html): Split bills and calculate tip amounts.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/percentage-calculator.html): Percentage increase, decrease, and ratio calculations.

## Health Tools
- [BMI Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/bmi-calculator.html): Body Mass Index calculator with WHO classification table, formula explanation, and FAQ. Supports kg/cm and lb/in.
- [Diet Plan](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/diet-plan.html): Personalized daily calorie and macro calculator based on age, weight, height, and activity level.

## Conversion & Date Tools
- [Unit Converter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/unit-converter.html): Length, weight, temperature, area, volume conversions.
- [Hijri Date Converter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/hijri-converter.html): Convert between Hijri (Islamic) and Gregorian calendar dates.
- [Age Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/age-calculator.html): Calculate exact age in years, months, and days.
- [Date Difference](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/date-diff.html): Number of days between two dates.
- [Timezone Converter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/timezone-converter.html): Convert time between world timezones.

## File & Image Tools
- [File Converter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/file-converter.html): Client-side file conversion — Word, Excel, CSV, PDF, images (JPG, PNG, WebP). No upload to server.
- [Image Compressor](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/image-compressor.html): Compress images in the browser without uploading. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP.
- [QR Generator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/qr-generator.html): Generate QR codes for any URL or text.

## Utility Tools
- [Password Generator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/password-generator.html): Generate secure random passwords with custom length and character sets.
- [Word Counter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/word-counter.html): Count words, characters, sentences, and reading time.
- [Random Number Generator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/random-number.html): Generate random numbers in a custom range.
- [Stopwatch](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/stopwatch.html): Precise stopwatch with lap timer.

## New in 2026 — Finance, Dev & Productivity
- [Zakat Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/zakat-calculator.html): 2.5% Zakat on cash, gold, silver, investments with Nisab check.
- [Fuel Cost Calculator](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/fuel-cost-calculator.html): Trip cost, L/100km, MPG with Gulf fuel presets (OMR/AED/SAR).
- [JSON Formatter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/json-formatter.html): Validate, beautify, minify JSON locally.
- [Base64 Encoder](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/base64-encoder.html): Unicode-safe Base64 encode/decode.
- [Color Converter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/color-converter.html): HEX/RGB/HSL picker with palettes.
- [Text Case Converter](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/text-case-converter.html): UPPER/lower/Title/Sentence + word counter.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/pomodoro-timer.html): 25/5 focus timer with sound & sessions.

- [Reaction Test](https://adawati2027.github.io/my-tools-site/reaction-test.html): Measure your reaction time in milliseconds.
